title: Movie Matinee: Blue Hawaii
seo_title: Movie Matinee: Blue Hawaii at Gillioz Theatre
description: This is a showing of the 1961 film Blue Hawaii starring Elvis Presley, in which Chadwick Gates returns home to Hawaii after leaving the U.S. Army, wants to surf all day, and is pushed by his family to work in their pineapple business. Tickets are general admission, and a combo with a ticket, a snack, and a non-alcoholic beverage is available; seniors 60+ get a free combo ticket with proof of ID on arrival. It takes place Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 2:00 PM at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri.
